intent_en: To demonstrate that empowering families to choose their desired number of children leads to a substantial decrease in the projected global population by the year 2100.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the substantial reduction in projected global population for the end of the century if families are given reproductive autonomy, contrasting the baseline estimate with a significantly lower outcome.
narration_support: If families get to choose how many kids they want, birth projections fall by 30 % to 2 .8 billion people.
chart_support: A dot-matrix bar chart displaying a population projection for the year 2100, establishing the baseline high population figure.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links family choice to reduced population projections, while the chart visualizes the population context for the year 2100 (showing a high baseline figure), supporting the topic of future population trends.
